worksheet.title: Email and Retention Plan Worksheet
worksheet.description: Plan how you will collect emails, what you will send, and how you will turn buyers into repeat customers.

fields.label: Email collection method
fields.helpText: How will you collect email addresses on your store? (e.g. pop-up with 10% discount, embedded form with free guide)

fields.label: Incentive offered
fields.helpText: What will you give in exchange for their email? (e.g. '10% off first order', 'free care guide PDF')

fields.label: Welcome email subject line
fields.helpText: The subject line of your first automated email. Keep it warm and direct.

fields.label: Welcome email key message
fields.helpText: What will you say in the welcome email? Deliver your promise, introduce yourself briefly, include a product link.

fields.label: Post-purchase follow-up plan
fields.helpText: What will you send after someone buys? Outline your post-purchase sequence: order confirmation, shipping notification, follow-up with review request.

fields.label: Repeat purchase strategy
fields.helpText: How will you encourage customers to come back? When will you contact them again, and with what offer or message?
